## Time-step bound: acoustic, implicit-advective, shear and diffusive (`integration/cfl`) {#sec-ch07-cfl}

### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**What it does.** Sets the step as the Courant factor times the smallest of the per-direction bounds over all
cells, ranks and local blocks, halved once per redo.
**Switch.** `integration/cfl` (pyharp, default 0.9); `integration/implicit-advection-cfl` (default 1, $>0$) and
`integration/shear-cfl` (default 0, off, $\ge0$), both only with `implicit-scheme`.
**Order.** Not a discretisation: a stability bound.
**Defining equation.** @eq-ch07-cfl-dt.
:::

In an explicit direction the bound is the acoustic Courant condition $\Delta x/(|v|+c_s)$. In the implicit
$x_1$ direction of the VIC the sound waves are treated implicitly, so only advection limits the step there, at
an advective Courant number `implicit-advection-cfl` that does not depend on `cfl`. An optional shear bound limits
the step where a horizontal wind jumps by more than the sound speed across an $x_1$ face, which the implicit
column cannot see. The diffusion module adds its parabolic bound (@sec-ch09-viscosity). The minimum is reduced
over all ranks and local blocks, multiplied by `cfl`, and halved for each redo of the step.

*Aliases.* chengcli/snapy#218 introduced the implicit-advective and shear bounds.

### Derivation

Let $C$ be `cfl`, $C_{\mathrm{adv}}$ `implicit-advection-cfl`, $C_{\mathrm{sh}}$ `shear-cfl`, $r$ the redo count
of the step, $h_a$ the width of a cell in direction $a$ and $c_s$ the sound speed. `HydroImpl::max_time_step`
returns, over interior cells,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\tau_a &= \min_{\mathrm{cells}}\frac{h_a}{|v_a|+c_s} \quad\text{explicit direction},\\
\tau_1 &= \min_{\mathrm{cells}}\frac{h_1}{|v_1|\,C/C_{\mathrm{adv}}} \quad\text{implicit direction},\\
\tau_{\mathrm{sh}} &= \min_{\mathrm{faces}}\frac{C_{\mathrm{sh}}}{C}\,\frac{c_f\,h_b}{|v_{b,i}|\,|v_{b,i+1}|} ,
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-ch07-cfl-bounds}

where the implicit direction is $x_1$, the shear minimum runs over the $x_1$ faces with $|v_{b,i+1}-v_{b,i}|\ge c_f$
only, $c_f$ is the mean sound speed of the two cells of the face and $b$ a horizontal direction, all in `dt_min`
([`hydro/hydro.cpp:326-375`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/hydro/hydro.cpp#L326-L375)). It also takes the diffusive bound $\tau_\nu$ of @sec-ch09-viscosity, from `pdiffusion`
([`hydro/hydro.cpp:396-398`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/hydro/hydro.cpp#L396-L398)). The block and the mesh then form

$$
\Delta t = 2^{-r}\,C\,\min_{\mathrm{ranks,\ blocks}}\min(\tau_a, \tau_1, \tau_{\mathrm{sh}}, \tau_\nu)
$$ {#eq-ch07-cfl-dt}

in `MeshBlockImpl::max_time_step` ([`meshblock.cpp:510-529`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L510-L529)) and `MeshImpl::max_time_step`
([`mesh.cpp:306-329`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/mesh.cpp#L306-L329)). Three consequences follow from @eq-ch07-cfl-bounds and @eq-ch07-cfl-dt, each
checked against a line-by-line port [check `src/snapy_report/ch07/cfl_check.py`, output `cfl_check.out`]:

1. In an explicit direction the acoustic Courant number $(|v_a|+c_s)\Delta t/h_a$ is $C$ (`[C1]`).
2. In the implicit $x_1$ direction the factor $C$ cancels: $|v_1|\Delta t/h_1 = C_{\mathrm{adv}}$ whatever $C$ is,
   so `implicit-advection-cfl` is the advective Courant number itself (`[C2]`).
3. The shear bound is $\Delta t = C_{\mathrm{sh}}\,c_f h_b/(|v_{b,i}||v_{b,i+1}|)$, again independent of $C$, and
   applies only on faces where the jump reaches $c_f$ (`[C4]`).

A column with $n_2=n_3=1$ keeps the acoustic bound in $x_1$ even with an implicit scheme (`[C3]`), and each redo halves the step (`[C5]`). Solid cells get $c_s=10^{-8}$ in the `solid` mask, so they never bind
([`hydro/hydro.cpp:322-324`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/hydro/hydro.cpp#L322-L324)).

The acoustic bound is the usual one for a Riemann-flux finite-volume scheme with explicit stages; the
implicit-advective bound and the shear bound are policies of chengcli/snapy#218, stated there as results only.
Neither is derived from a stability analysis of the VIC in this draft.

### Numerical method

See @fig-ch07-cfl-bounds for the bounds on one face of a 2-D column.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch07-cfl-bounds
#| fig-cap: "The bounds that set the step on a 2-D column with an implicit $x_1$ direction. Green: the advective bound in $x_1$, with Courant number $C_{\\mathrm{adv}}$; orange: the acoustic bound in $x_2$, $(|v_2|+c_s)\\,\\Delta t/\\Delta x_2 \\leq C$; vermillion: an $x_1$ face where the horizontal wind jumps by at least the face sound speed $c_f$ (in $\\mathrm{m\\,s^{-1}}$), which adds the shear bound. The step is the smallest, halved per redo $r$, over all ranks."
#| fig-alt: "Six cells with a green double arrow along x1, an orange double arrow along x2 and one vertical face highlighted in vermillion, next to the four formulas of the bounds."
#| echo: false
from snapy_report.ch07.fig_cfl_bounds import make_fig
make_fig()
```

The bounds are taken over interior cells only, on the primitive state at the start of the step. The global
minimum is one `allreduce` with `MIN` before the factors are applied, so every rank takes the same step and the
redo factor of the first local block applies to all blocks of a Mesh.

: Code map of the time-step bound. {#tbl-ch07-cfl-code}

1. `ImplicitOptionsImpl::from_yaml` reads the two keys, requires finite values, $C_{\mathrm{adv}}>0$ and
   $C_{\mathrm{sh}}\ge0$, and refuses either key without `implicit-scheme` ([`implicit_hydro.cpp:24-69`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/implicit/implicit_hydro.cpp#L24-L69)).
2. `HydroImpl::max_time_step` forms @eq-ch07-cfl-bounds and the diffusive bound ([`hydro/hydro.cpp:311-398`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/hydro/hydro.cpp#L311-L398)).
3. `MeshBlockImpl::max_time_step` reduces with `MIN` over ranks and applies @eq-ch07-cfl-dt
   ([`meshblock.cpp:510-529`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L510-L529)); `MeshImpl::max_time_step` first takes the minimum over local blocks
   ([`mesh.cpp:306-329`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/mesh.cpp#L306-L329)).

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
No sedimentation-velocity bound enters the step: settling is protected only by the positivity limiter
(@sec-ch08). A one-dimensional column keeps the acoustic bound even with the VIC.
:::

1. **Implicit $x_2$ and $x_3$ are unreachable.** The bound reads scheme bits 1 and 2 of `scheme` ([`hydro/hydro.cpp:341-351`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/hydro/hydro.cpp#L341-L351)),
   but only schemes 0, 1 and 9 are accepted by `type` ([`implicit_hydro.cpp:84-98`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/implicit/implicit_hydro.cpp#L84-L98)).
2. **The 1-D exception.** A column with $n_2=n_3=1$ keeps the acoustic $x_1$ bound in `denom1` ([`hydro/hydro.cpp:334-337`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/hydro/hydro.cpp#L334-L337)), so a 1-D VIC run silently runs at the explicit step
   (`sources/canoe__tall_column_instability_TECH_REPORT.md` §3f).
3. **Existing decks changed step.** Introducing the advective bound changed the step of existing scheme 1 and 9
   decks without a warning (chengcli/snapy#218, Compatibility; `sources/gh__PR_BODIES_202-219.md`).
4. **No derivation of the implicit bounds.** $C_{\mathrm{adv}}$ and $C_{\mathrm{sh}}$ are policies; their stability
   margins are not derived or measured here.
